findings.title: C84 hand-fit heat limit names the wrong bottom joints under C84's lands
findings.contradicts: docs/ORDERING.md 8.2 (line 435, R19-MEC-02): "Four bottom joints sit directly under C84's lands (L1.2 3V3, C7.2 GND, C9.1 3V3, C9.2 GND; also L1.1 at 0.60 mm and C7.1 at 0.90 mm)"; docs/R10_VALIDATION.md line 2755 repeats it ("L1.2, C7.2, C9.1, C9.2; L1.1 0.60 mm and C7.1 0.90 mm away").
findings.evidence: Read-only pcbnew on a copy of 92c3ad59 (copper polygons, top land vs bottom pad, XY projection). C84 F(27.5,78.5) 90 deg: land 1 (VLOGIC) x 26.65-28.35, y 80.00-83.50; land 2 (GND) x 26.65-28.35, y 73.50-77.00 (also F_Mask/F_Cu Gerber flashes R 1.7x3.5 at (27.5,81.75)/(27.5,75.25)). Bottom pads (all rectangles): L1.1 SW_NODE x 23.25-26.75, y 72.20-73.80 overlaps land 2 by 0.03 mm2 (not 0.60 mm away); C7.1 VLOGIC y 72.095-73.505 overlaps land 2 by 0.0036 mm2 (abuts; not 0.90 mm away); C9.1 3V3 x 24.695-26.105 is 0.545 mm from land 1 (not directly under); L1.2 0.16 mm2, C7.2 1.022 mm2, C9.2 1.290 mm2 under (correct). Also near and unlisted: C8.2 GND 0.605 mm and C8.1 3V3 0.814 mm from land 2. Positions unchanged in r10_place.tsv since the D-AVA placement (L1 B(25,74.6) -90, C7 B(28.3,73.8) -90, C8 B(26.4,78.28) 0, C9 B(26.4,80.24) 0). Probe: .supervisor/r26_manufacturing (c84 polygon intersection script output in this review).
findings.impact: The heat-limit procedure tells the fitter which bottom joints get conducted heat and which to inspect; it lists C9.1 as under the land when it is not, places L1.1 and C7.1 at a distance when both are under the lands, and omits C8 (0.605 mm), which is as near as the stated L1.1 figure and is not in the fixture or inspection list (L1, C7, C9, R166).
findings.concrete_fix: In ORDERING 8.2 and R10_VALIDATION line 2755: "Five bottom joints sit under C84's lands (L1.1 SW_NODE, L1.2 3V3, C7.1 VLOGIC at its edge, C7.2 GND, C9.2 GND); C9.1 3V3 is 0.545 mm and C8.2 / C8.1 0.605 / 0.814 mm away." Add C8 to the fixture keep-off and post-fit inspection lists.

findings.title: J3 slot hand-finish neighbours omit R7, which is nearer than R8
findings.contradicts: docs/ORDERING.md 8.2 line 461: "Hand-finish all four J3 shell slots for hole fill, keeping the iron off bottom C83 and R8."; docs/R10_VALIDATION.md line 518 (R7-MFG-03): "Fixed: C83 / R8, 1.95 / 2.15 mm copper gap".
findings.evidence: Read-only pcbnew, B.Cu effective shapes, copper edge to edge from the J3 shell slot pads (J3.1 x 5.26-7.36 y 34.525-35.725; J3.4 x 5.26-7.36 y 25.875-27.075, oval): C83.1 1.952 mm (J3.4), R7.2 (GND, x 8.73-9.27 y 28.187-28.753, R7 B(9,28.9) 90 deg) 2.010 mm (J3.4), R8.1 2.145 mm (J3.1), then R9.2 2.785 mm. R7 is the second-nearest bottom part and nearer than R8; it is in neither statement. R7's pose is unchanged in r10_place.tsv since the D-AVA placement.
findings.impact: The bottom-side hand-finish instruction protects C83 and R8 but not R7 (USB CC1 pull-down), which sits closer to the J3.4 slot than R8 does to J3.1.
findings.concrete_fix: ORDERING 8.2: "keeping the iron off bottom C83, R7 and R8 (1.952 / 2.010 / 2.145 mm copper gap)"; R10_VALIDATION R7-MFG-03 row: "C83 / R7 / R8, 1.95 / 2.01 / 2.15 mm copper gap".
